success.description: 1 You grow and shape the nearby flora to create a natural wall of thorny, tough plants. The wall can be shaped into a circle blocking any exit. The wall requires a Hard (3{Dc}) Athletics check (or comparable) to break through it, failing to do so suffers 1 wound. The wall disappears when this blessing has recharged.
